نرتعي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَعِي (nartaʕī) /nar.ta.ʕiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَى (irtaʕā)
# نَرْتَعِيَ (nartaʕiya) /nar.ta.ʕi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَى (irtaʕā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
